Changing requirements. It's just... we all know this. The facts will change. When the facts change, do not dig in. Do it over again and see if your answer is still valid in the context of the new requirements, the new facts. And if it isn't, change your mind. Don't apologize. Sometimes, you'll just make mistakes, errors on logic or you just get it wrong. That's fine. If I could advocate anything, that's 'Do not be afraid' especially, 'do not be afraid of being wrong.'
